headline: AVERAGE SALARY IN SERBIA FROM 2016 TO 2026: See the Figures, Huge Improvement and Prosperity for Citizens
summary: Average net salary in Serbia has more than doubled over the last ten years, and growth continues in 2026, according to NOVOSTI.
why: Wage levels shape consumer spending, labour costs and investment attractiveness in an economy, which matters for investors assessing Serbia.
